streaming_input.text: It's understandable to feel unsteady this soon. For tonight, keep one simple
routine, put the most upsetting reminders out of sight, and text one trusted person
rather than carrying the loneliness alone.
Stay near Naomi and agree on a check-in signal. Park where you can leave
easily, and if Rowan approaches, try, “I’m not ready to
talk tonight.” Ground yourself with a slow breath and your feet on the floor;
leaving early is allowed, not a failure.
